title: [GMCP 203.010.M] Mastery: Complete resource server surface
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-010-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: Static and templated resources support deterministic discovery, URI completion, text and binary reads, metadata, pagination/filtering, cache semantics, list and update notifications, modern filtered subscriptions, authorization, cancellation, and bounded streaming. URI-template matching, traversal, races, stale cache, not-found semantics, MIME handling, and large-resource behavior pass positive and adversarial fixtures. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
